00:00:05 Today we are going to talk about testing strategy, and why it matters more than most teams realize when a deadline is looming.
00:00:30 Write the test first, then the code; this is test-driven development, and it forces you to think about the interface before the implementation.
00:12:30 Never weaken a guarantee just to make a test pass, because a passing test that lies to you is worse than an honest failure.
